cases.doc: A migration step changed a per-token ledger total.
cases.name: MigrationInvariantViolated

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Namespaced escrow tag. `owner` is the integrator whose namespace the
tag lives in (e.g. options_market's own address), `kind` separates id
spaces inside one integrator (`series` vs `position`), and `id` is the
integrator's own identifier. Two integrators \xe2\x80\x94 or two kinds inside one
integrator \xe2\x80\x94 can never collide on the same ledger entry, because the
full triple is the storage key.

Stored as a plain struct rather than a `BytesN<32>` hash: the key is
only an address + a short symbol + a u64 larger than a hash, and in
exchange events and storage stay self-describing (no preimage registry
needed to tell what a hash refers to).
udt_struct_v0.name: Tag

void_v0.doc: The token passed to `initialize`: the default token the `_legacy`\nwrappers operate on.
void_v0.name: Token

void_v0.doc: Namespace owner that `u64` legacy tags map into \xe2\x80\x94 the admin at\ninitialize time, fixed thereafter so a later transfer_admin can't\norphan legacy balances.
void_v0.name: LegacyOwner

tuple_v0.doc: Token allowlist: only allowed tokens accept new deposits.
tuple_v0.name: AllowedToken

tuple_v0.doc: Integrator registry: only registered integrators may create tags.
tuple_v0.name: Integrator

tuple_v0.doc: Recorded on a tag's first deposit; gates withdraw/transfer_tag.
tuple_v0.name: TagOwner

void_v0.doc: Schema v2: every token with a `TotalEscrowed` entry, so migrations\nand invariant checks can enumerate the ledger.
void_v0.name: Tokens

udt_union_v0.doc: Storage keys of the pre-multi-token, pre-namespace vault. Encodes\nidentically to the old `DataKey::Escrow(u64)` / `DataKey::TotalEscrowed`\nso `migrate_legacy` can read (and clear) entries written by it.
udt_union_v0.name: LegacyKey

function_v0.doc: Permissionless keeper entrypoint: extends the contract instance and\nevery named persistent entry that exists, per the TTL policy in\nttl.rs. Anyone may pay the rent to keep long-lived entries alive.
function_v0.name: bump

function_v0.doc:
Hands off control to a new address. Requires the CURRENT admin's
signature, not the incoming one. The admin configures the vault
(token allowlist, integrator registry, pause, sweep) but owns no
integrator's tags, so this never hands over escrowed funds.
function_v0.name: transfer_admin

function_v0.doc:
Permissionless alternative to transfer_admin: cross-calls a
deployed Multisig and checks is_approved(action_id) instead of
requiring the current admin's own signature \xe2\x80\x94 same pattern as
options_market's and price_oracle's transfer_admin_via_multisig.
function_v0.name: transfer_admin_via_multisig

function_v0.doc:
Emergency stop: blocks deposit, withdraw, and transfer_tag. Both
sides, unlike options_market's pause (which only blocks new
exposure, not winding existing positions down) \xe2\x80\x94 a vault holding
real funds should be freezable outright if something's gone wrong.
function_v0.name: pause

function_v0.doc: Permissionless alternative to pause(), same rationale and pattern\nas options_market's and price_oracle's pause_via_multisig.
function_v0.name: pause_via_multisig

function_v0.doc: Adds or removes `token` from the allowlist. Removing a token only\nblocks NEW deposits of it: existing balances stay withdrawable,\ntransferable, and sweepable.
function_v0.name: set_token_allowed

function_v0.doc: Registers (or deregisters) an integrator allowed to create tags in\nits own namespace. Deregistering blocks new tags only; tags it\nalready owns keep working.
function_v0.name: set_integrator

function_v0.doc:
Pulls `amount` of `token` from `from` into the vault, crediting
`(token, tag)`. `from` must authorize the transfer. The first
deposit into a tag records `tag.owner` as its owner; that requires
`tag.owner` to be a registered integrator and to authorize (which
it already has when it is also `from`). End users can therefore
deposit into a contract-owned tag only with that contract's auth.

Credits the measured balance delta, not `amount`, and returns it:
with a fee-on-transfer token the tag is credited what actually
arrived. Costs two extra token balance reads per deposit.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc:
Pays `amount` of `(token, tag)`'s escrow to `to`. Requires the
tag owner's signature \xe2\x80\x94 in the intended integration that is the
calling contract itself, so the contract-to-contract call
satisfies require_auth() through the call itself.

Panics with InsufficientEscrowBalance if `tag` doesn't have that
much earmarked, regardless of other tags' deposits. Emits
`shortfall_detected` if the vault's actual balance of `token` is
below its ledger (e.g. after a clawback), and panics with
InsufficientVaultBalance instead of a token error if it can't
cover this payout.
function_v0.name: withdraw

function_v0.doc:
Emergency payout without the tag owner: requires multisig approval
(e.g. the owning contract is being replaced and can't sign). Same
InsufficientEscrowBalance cap applies \xe2\x80\x94 approval changes who can
call this, not how much any tag is entitled to.
function_v0.name: withdraw_via_multisig

function_v0.doc:
Moves `amount` of `token` escrow from `from_tag` to `to_tag` with
no token movement \xe2\x80\x94 e.g. options_market's roll_position. Requires
`from_tag`'s owner; if `to_tag` belongs to (or would be created
for) a different owner, that owner must authorize too.
function_v0.name: transfer_tag

function_v0.doc:
Emergency alternative to transfer_tag, gated on multisig approval.
A `to_tag` that doesn't exist yet is recorded as owned by
`to_tag.owner`, so funds only ever land in their namespace owner's
control.
function_v0.name: transfer_tag_via_multisig

function_v0.doc: `max(0, TotalEscrowed(token) \xe2\x88\x92 actual balance)`: how much of the\nledger the vault can no longer back, e.g. after a SAC clawback.
function_v0.name: get_shortfall

function_v0.doc: The default token the `_legacy` wrappers operate on.\nTokens the ledger has a total for (see `DataKey::Tokens`).
function_v0.name: get_tokens

function_v0.doc:
Recovers tokens that landed on the vault's own address OUTSIDE
deposit() \xe2\x80\x94 e.g. a direct token transfer sent straight to this
contract's address by mistake, rather than through deposit(),
which is the only path that actually credits a tag's ledger. Those
tokens sit in the vault's real balance but aren't accounted for
under any tag, so they'd otherwise be stuck forever: no tag's
withdraw could ever reach them (withdraw is capped at that tag's
OWN escrowed balance), and get_total_escrowed's ledger sum would
permanently under-report the vault's actual token balance.
function_v0.name: sweep_untagged

function_v0.doc: Permissionless alternative to sweep_untagged, gated on multisig\napproval.
function_v0.name: sweep_untagged_via_multisig

function_v0.doc: The namespaced tag a legacy `u64` id maps to:\n`(legacy owner, "legacy", id)`, where the legacy owner is the\nadmin at initialize time.
function_v0.name: legacy_tag

function_v0.doc:
Moves pre-upgrade `Escrow(u64)` entries (single-token, bare-u64
tags) to `Escrow(default token, legacy_tag(id))`, owned by the
current admin. The old `TotalEscrowed` moves on the first call.
Idempotent: ids with no legacy entry are skipped.
function_v0.name: migrate_legacy
